findings.text: follow-on: the section-effort read is gated on provenance == 'plan-fallback', so a section's own declared effort is silently dropped wherever the plan declares no plan-effort-hours, leaving estimated_hours null where the section declares an independent figure; 26 of 162 live plans carry no such meta, so the difficulty signal the change exists to surface is lost for those.

follow-on: the evidence fragment and the head gate log name revision ea8694d45, one docs-only commit below the reviewed head c65e4fe8d, so the recorded arm does not name the reviewed head; harmless here because c65e4fe8d changes only the evidence fragment.

item_verdicts.diff: read the three commits against base 23f64fb23; they introduce _section_effort_hours, rework _declared_difficulty so the plan is resolved once and the estimate takes node-then-section-then-plan precedence, render estimated_hours_source unconditionally, and update the section-effort tests, the two pinned-state tests and the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_jev_sees_declared_difficulty.py and the picker suite; the manifest records the base arm (179 passed, EXIT 0) and the head arm (196 passed, 1 failed, EXIT 1) with logs on disk, and an independent re-run of the three touched test files at the reviewed head c65e4fe8d passed 22 of 22 in 1.45s.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that Jev's rendered state carries the effort a node's plan section declares ahead of the plan total; reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:126 now reads the section record's effort through routing._section_record and overrides the plan figure it is charged with.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits 2f51d0d06, ea8694d45 and c65e4fe8d, both gate arms and both negative controls, but carries no armed baseline_suite/after_suite JSON, so the added failures were derived directly from the logs it names, logs/base-gate.log and logs/head-gate.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the three commits against base 23f64fb23; every path in them (docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/jev-sees-declared-difficulty.html, reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py, reckon/crew/picker/prompts.py, tests/test_jev_sees_declared_difficulty.py, tests/test_jev_prompt_carries_what_it_weighs.py, tests/test_picker_helpers_have_one_owner.py) sits inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: tests/test_jev_sees_declared_difficulty.py:171 and :185 assert the section effort and its source on the rendered state, and disabling the section-effort read reddens both section-effort tests (48.0 against the declared 10.0 and 4.0); no test covers a plan that declares no total, the gap the first finding records.
justifications.evidence: logs/base-gate.log (179 passed, EXIT 0) and logs/head-gate.log (196 passed, 1 failed, EXIT 1) are on disk and both negative controls are recorded; the head arm carries one unrelated flake and its header names ea8694d45, one docs-only commit below the reviewed head c65e4fe8d.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:65 reuses routing._section_record and prompts.py:187 renders estimated_hours_source unconditionally, matching the module idiom, but it imports a private helper across modules and its docstring says the plan is resolved once while routing._estimated_hours resolves the plan again internally.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:145 gates the section-effort read on provenance == 'plan-fallback', so a section's own declared effort is dropped and the state renders estimated_hours null whenever the plan carries no plan-effort-hours meta (26 of 162 live plans), short of the node>section>plan order the change states.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:65 reuses routing._section_record and the routing resolver rather than forking effort parsing; no duplicated capability was introduced.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the three commits against base 23f64fb23 sits inside the six declared write paths; nothing outside the goal was touched.
